works.body:
Hello! I really like your work, I hope I can ask you to draw a picture for my original characters ( ´ ▽ ` )ノ 💕

The girl with white hair is a high school student, she's the youngest sister, very cute and lively. She loves her big brother and often fights with him.
The man with black hair is the second brother, he looks cold, but he is a good-hearted person, but a little arrogant. He likes his big brother, but doesn't dare to say so.
The man with white hair is the eldest brother, he is a gentle man, but also the head of the family, when his younger siblings are in conflict, he will be in the middle to coordinate them.

I would like you to draw a picture of a family living in harmony! You can play with the content of the picture yourself, thanks again very much! Thank you again!

Here is the reference link:

ARI, nice to meet you! I like your work very much!
I would like to ask you to illustrate two characters for me. The character introductions and references are summarized in the following information. If you have trouble seeing the details of the characters' costumes, you are free to omit the details or draw that part freely.
https://imgur.com/a/wDKcd3b
https://imgur.com/a/YoesuoU
https://imgur.com/a/c46m6vJ

Character introduction:
The character with white hair: aggressive (black eyes, height 180cm). Cool and manly, somewhat solitary and freedom loving. He is a warrior with high fighting ability. He uses two swords as weapons and shows his crazy side during battle. He is a ghost disguised as a pocket watch. He loves drinking and the moon.
The character with blue hair: Receiver (light gray eyes, height 179cm). He is kind and gentle, and sometimes teases people. He is somewhat idealistic. He is a military strategist with a high knowledge of tactics. He is a ghost disguised as a compass and has the ability to foretell the future. His hobbies are tea, writing, and giving candy to children who pass by. His wish is to have a good night's sleep.

The atmosphere when they are together:
1. they feel connected, have an extraordinary understanding of the other, and maintain sufficient respect, but both want to have a deeper relationship with the other.
2. you like the feeling that they are unconsciously approaching the other and that they are working hard toward the same goal.
Their relationship is more like that of a casual brother or an aged companion who has been married for many years than a sweet couple.

I will leave the illustration up to you!
Best regards!

Thank you ARI for your beautiful work - I hope you will illustrate the story between these three next time!

The white-haired genie: a nice person who is easily angered. He is a friend of the red-haired genie and always can't help the other one.
(Actually, in his heart, he has special feelings for the red-haired genie.)

Red-haired Genie: The father of the red-haired girl is a doomed hero. Raised in a human village, he is a clever merchant, seemingly indifferent, but always doing amazing things.

Narrative: since humans and spirits are not allowed to fall in love, the red-haired spirit and her daughter are hunted by the clan, and the red-haired spirit does not want either the spirit or the human to be harmed. She finally decided to seal herself off, give all her life span to her daughter, and then leave her daughter in the care of the white-haired spirit.


Red-haired girl: half spirit, the child of a spirit and a human. Her mother died after she was born. Her father gave her all her lifetimes and then she is cared for by a white-haired spirit, who travels with her.

Screens for reference: three people lying in a meadow full of little daisies/ treehouse life/ white-haired genie and girl on the run/ red-haired and white-haired genie making noise.

Compositions of two or three of them, 黑白漫画/黑白插图 are welcome. Clothing can be changed freely. Please enjoy drawing!

Greetings, Mr. ARI. If you don't mind, I would like to ask you to take care of two of my self-created master-servants.

The blond boy is the main one. He is half vampire and half human. He has a lot of emotions, but he would never do anything to hurt the maid. I like old things, old-fashioned machines and gears, and Japanese food.
The light blue girl is my maid. She is a half-beast. She is innocent and cute. She loves the Lord and cakes. The two of them are not in love, but they are good friends.
May I leave the composition of the picture to you?

I would appreciate your consideration.

Hi, I just wanted to let you know that I am very pleased with your work! I loved your beautiful work very much!

I hope you can draw my original character!

1. a gray-haired young man is the owner of a young manor. He is kind and patiently puts up with others, there is no great change in his countenance as he has made a deal with the dragon to save his city from being destroyed by the dragon and has given his soul.

2. Another one with dark blue hair transforms from the dragon, loves to be with the white-haired manor owner. He accompanies the white-haired young man in the manor as a servant. These two are very happy in their life together, but their attitude towards any stranger is very indifferent.

I like your work very much, so feel free to change the composition and clothing! Anyway, have fun painting them. They are very close and trust each other.

I hope you can draw freely! (黑白は大欢迎です)

Hello ARI-sensei!
I love ARI-sensei's illustrations so much that I definitely wanted to commission him someday! Thank you for giving me the opportunity!
This time I sent a request for you to draw my original character.
I have sent you two materials for two people to be drawn if possible, but either one of them would be fine!
If the amount is insufficient or inconvenient, you can cancel this request.

The two characters I want you to draw are Satori and Nagira.
They have known each other since high school and now work together at an amusement park.
Nagira is the park manager and Satori is an employee.
Satori suffers from hearing loss and is often helped by nagira.

I will use the illustrations for personal use only.
I may show them off on social networking sites, but I will post them in such a way that it is clear that they were drawn by Mr. ARI.
I will leave the composition of the illustration and the facial expressions of the characters to Mr. ARI.
We hope you will consider our proposal!
